Subject: Initial DPA and transfer annexes (AcmeCloud -> Redwood)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for continuing the conversation with AcmeCloud. Attached is our current DPA with track changes (AcmeCloud_DPA_v3_redlines.docx). Our legal team is looking for confirmation that Redwood can: 

- Incorporate the EU SCCs (European Commission standard clauses) as an appendix,
- Execute a UK IDTA addendum or equivalent for UK transfers,
- Provide an exportable subprocessor CSV and 30-day notice for any new subprocessors,
- Provide executed evidence (SCCs/IDTA) via DocuSign where possible.

Could you confirm an internal owner for the DPA redlines and a target date for signature? We are hoping to finalize by Dec 15 to align with our onboarding window.

Attached: AcmeCloud_DPA_v3_redlines.docx (redlines from Acme legal)

Best,
Sara Perez
Sr. Procurement Manager
AcmeCloud

Subject: Re: Initial DPA and transfer annexes (AcmeCloud -> Redwood)

Hi Sara — thanks for sending the redlines and timeline.

Internal owners: Karthik (legal/contracting) will lead redline response; Marissa will coordinate evidence/subprocessor exports and the DocuSign flow. I'll be the primary PM for execution and timeline.

A few quick notes from an operational standpoint:
- We can append the EU SCCs as an executed appendix — we typically include the SCC text as an appendix and sign the overall DPA via DocuSign.
- For UK transfers, Redwood accepts an IDTA/UK addendum in the standard template. We do prefer to keep the language aligned with our global transfer approach; Karthik will propose limited edits if needed.
- Subprocessor visibility: we maintain a CSV of active subprocessors and can provide a snapshot and an S3/Drive link; 30-day notice is generally acceptable but where subprocessor is critical we may propose an exception workflow for emergency patches.

Can you confirm Acme legal's preferred signature method (DocuSign vs AdobeSign)? DocuSign is easiest for our ops team.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
1) Redwood internal redline response by Dec 3
2) Exchange SCCs/IDTA appendix drafts by Dec 5
3) Final sign-off and DocuSign envelope by Dec 10

If that timeline works, we'll proceed and copy you on the evidence export.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Partnerships (contract ops)
Redwood Inference
(tessa_morgan@redwood.ai)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Acme DPA redlines — proposed internal responses and IDTA language

Team — forwarding Acme's redlines. Quick notes inline below (this is internal only).

[Quoted: Acme redlines summary]
- Clause 4.2 (Subprocessors): Acme insists on 30-day notice + right to object.
- Clause 7 (Transfers): requests explicit IDTA wording and Seller obligations re: SCCs.

Our proposed approach:
1) Accept 30-day notice as a baseline; push back on unilateral customer veto that would require contract-by-contract subprocessor approvals. Offer a right to object on reasonable security grounds + option for Acme to terminate for cause if objection sustained.
2) SCCs: propose to include the standard EU SCCs as an appendix and mark Redwood as data importer. Add operational clause that SCCs will be executed via DocuSign alongside the DPA.
3) UK IDTA: prepare the Redwood UK addendum draft and flag two sentences Karthik may want to soften re: onward transfers to subprocessors.

Ask: Karthik — can you prepare a clean redline with the SCCs appended by EOD 3 Dec? Marissa — please prepare the current subprocessor snapshot and evidence we can attach.

Thanks,
Tessa

From: Sara Perez <sara.perez@acmecloud.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Miguel Ortiz <m.ortiz@acmecloud.com>, legal@acmecloud.com
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 07:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Initial DPA and transfer annexes (AcmeCloud -> Redwood)

Tessa — appreciate the quick coordination. A few clarifications from Acme legal: 

- Subprocessor objections: Acme will need a documented right to object for up to 30 days; termination for cause is an acceptable remedy but they want to avoid operational exposure if a critical subprocessor is added with no remediation window. Would Redwood consider an emergency exception process (e.g., security critical patches) that requires immediate notice plus a post-facto remediation report?
- SCCs execution: Acme's procurement team prefers a single envelope that includes both the DPA and the SCC appendix so our legal can have a single executed record.
- UK IDTA: Acme will want the addendum executed and recorded similar to the SCC appendix.

Also: are there any limited categories of subprocessors that Redwood might exclude from the 30-day notice (e.g., CDN endpoints, ephemeral cloud managed services)? If so, we can scope those out to shorten review cycles.

Can you also confirm whether Redwood will accept Acme-specific redlines on security obligations (we redlined a few items in Clause 8)?

Thanks — hoping to align quickly so we can hit that Dec 15 onboarding.

Best,
Sara

---
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Perez <sara.perez@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:16:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Initial DPA and transfer annexes (AcmeCloud -> Redwood)

Sara — thanks, and good questions. Short answers below and an updated action plan attached.

- Emergency exception process: Yes — we can accept an emergency patch exception for security-critical subprocessors that requires immediate notice to Acme with a documented remediation timeline and a post-implementation report within 14 days. We'll add that as an operational appendix rather than a contractual carve-out.
- Single envelope for DPA + SCCs + UK IDTA: Agreed. We'll assemble the DPA, SCC appendix, and UK IDTA addendum into one DocuSign envelope so Acme has a single executed artifact.
- Subprocessor categories: We propose a short list of low-risk categories (CDN edge cache, DNS providers, ephemeral infra provisioners) that are subject to a 7-day notice rather than 30 days; Marissa has the current mapping attached.
- Security redlines: Karthik reviewed the redlined language and proposes accepting core obligations with clarifications around liability caps and triage timeline commitments. He will provide the redline response by EOD today (Dec 3).

Next steps (finalized):
1) Karthik to provide clean redline and SCCs/IDTA appendix by Dec 3 (EOD) — ON TRACK
2) Marissa to attach subprocessor snapshot + evidence (CSV + SOC2 link) — SENT
3) Tessa to assemble DocuSign envelope and propose signing window (target: Dec 10)

Attachments: SCCs_and_UK_IDTA_appendix_draft.pdf, Redwood_Subprocessors_20261201.csv

If that works, we'll queue DocuSign and loop in Acme procurement for the envelope.

Thanks,
Tessa
